summary: Android has a top navigation bar with a back arrow and "Connected Apps" page title; React uses an inline compact header with a link icon and "CONNECTED APPS" eyebrow text.

React header lays out "CONNECTED APPS" eyebrow, an "EXPERIMENTAL" green pill, and a pink "+ Register app" button on one row; Android places "EXPERIMENTAL" pill and "+ Register app" button inside the content card on a separate row.

Stats tiles differ: React shows "Marketplace 3 / Installed 2 / My apps 1" as labeled tab buttons; Android renders the counts as large numbers (3, 2, 1) on top with labels below, and duplicates them as a second row of tab buttons with icons (store, check, key) below.
Android adds an extra "Built-in" section header above the GitHub card and lists additional GitHub sub-detail (github.com URL) that React does not show.

Marketplace cards: React uses large square letter avatars (SB, GI) with full-width descriptions and bottom-aligned action buttons ("Install", "INSTALLED" green pill, "PRODUCTIVITY"/"DEVELOPMENT" tag pills). Android uses no avatars, wraps metadata inline ("Productivity · Raft Labs · Messages and channel metadata"), and replaces Install/Installed with "Details" buttons.
likelyCauses: Android and React teams implemented the screen independently from different design specs rather than sharing a single component/token library.
Android added its own app-bar/back-arrow navigation pattern (Material) not present on the React web version.
Android restyled stat counters and tab navigation independently, creating a duplicate "stats + tabs" row.
Android variant captures a shorter viewport (868 vs 969), so the bottom footer and trailing cards are not rendered/visible in the comparison crop.
Different iconography set on Android (store/check/key/eye/external-link) vs none on React.
suggestedFixes: Reconcile the screen-level header: align on a single header pattern across web and Android (either both use inline compact header or both use a back-arrow app bar).
Unify the stats layout: pick one representation (labeled counts as buttons OR big-number tiles) and remove the duplicate row on Android.
Standardize card composition: avatar, title, metadata line, description, and a single action button per card across platforms.
Move "EXPERIMENTAL" pill to a consistent position (header vs inside card) and match color/styling tokens.
Replicate the React action-button style on Android (solid pink filled) or update the design system so both platforms use the same outlined-with-icon variant intentionally.
intentional: Stat counts (3, 2, 1) match in value across both variants, just rendered differently.
